subject: The threshold of marriage and the first promise
era: Contemporary - the inner life of a marriage
place: A family room, then the symbolic first room of the home
events: A young woman enters marriage as a question and a promise, sensing that a home begins before it has walls.
The promise moves from words into daily practice.
grounding_notes: Refined to Experienced level: image-rich, emotionally coherent, and grounded in the wife epic.
The domestic setting is universal/contemporary rather than tied to a single historical event.
